Willem Diepeveen Willem Diepeveen Menu Home Publications Teaching Willem Diepeveen Hedrick Assistant Adjunct Professor , Department of Mathematics, UCLA I am a Hedrick Assistant Adjunct Professor in the Department of Mathematics at UCLA, hosted by Deanna Needell and Andrea Bertozzi , where I also work closely with Oscar Leong . Previously, I completed my PhD at University of Cambridge , supervised by Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb , and hold a double MSc from TU Delft and TU Berlin , and a double BSc from TU Delft . My research lies at the interface of Riemannian geometry, signal processing, and machine learning , with a focus on developing geometric algorithms for inverse problems, scientific data analysis, and high-dimensional inference. My work combines theoretical rigor with practical performance , while emphasizing robustness and interpretability in settings where black-box models fall short. I am currently on the academic job market for faculty positions in mathematics, applied mathematics, and related interdisciplinary areas. Beyond research, I enjoy teaching mathematics at UCLA, mentoring graduate and undergraduate students, and engaging in interdisciplinary collaborations. I am also an avid hiker, swimmer, sailor, skier and snowboarder, and a classics and poetry enthusiast.
